import math
import numpy as np

# Camera at frame 86:
cam_x, cam_y, theta_deg = 1.749, 3.439, 345.0 # which is -15 deg!
theta_rad = math.radians(theta_deg)

# Let's re-project chair leg at u=50.5, v=353:
u, v = 50.5, 353
Z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256.0) / 256.0)
X_c = ((u - 256.0) / 256.0) * Z_c
wx = cam_x + Z_c * math.sin(theta_rad) + X_c * math.cos(theta_rad)
wy = cam_y + Z_c * math.cos(theta_rad) - X_c * math.sin(theta_rad)
print(f'Chair leg (u={u}, v={v}): Z_c={Z_c:.3f}, X_c={X_c:.3f} -> world=({wx:.3f}, {wy:.3f})')

# Stool legs in obs_0086 (visible on the right)
# Let's inspect right side of obs_0086
import cv2
img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0086.png')
mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img[:, :, 0] < 110) & (img[:, :, 1] > 70) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img[:, :, 2] < 110)
pts = np.argwhere(mask)
pts_stool = pts[(pts[:, 1] > 350) & (pts[:, 1] < 480) & (pts[:, 0] > 320)]
for u_range in [(380, 410), (420, 440), (445, 470)]:
    sub = pts_stool[(pts_stool[:, 1] >= u_range[0]) & (pts_stool[:, 1] <= u_range[1])]
    if len(sub) > 0:
        v_bot = np.max(sub[:, 0])
        u_c = np.mean(sub[sub[:, 0] == v_bot, 1])
        Z_c = 1.55 / ((v_bot - 256.0) / 256.0)
        X_c = ((u_c - 256.0) / 256.0) * Z_c
        wx = cam_x + Z_c * math.sin(theta_rad) + X_c * math.cos(theta_rad)
        wy = cam_y + Z_c * math.cos(theta_rad) - X_c * math.sin(theta_rad)
        print(f'Stool leg (u={u_c:.1f}, v={v_bot}): Z_c={Z_c:.3f}, X_c={X_c:.3f} -> world=({wx:.3f}, {wy:.3f})')
"
